faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our services and process
faq.0.question: What services does Quartz offer?
faq.0.answer: We provide four core services: custom software development, business process automation, quality assurance and testing, and cybersecurity solutions. You can use one service or combine several, depending on the project.
faq.1.question: How long does a typical project take?
faq.1.answer: Scope and schedule depend on your project’s requirements and complexity. After the diagnostic, we agree them in a written plan before signing.
faq.2.question: Where is your team based?
faq.2.answer: We work remotely with clients worldwide, mostly in the US and Europe, with one dedicated lead per project.
faq.3.question: What is your development methodology?
faq.3.answer: We work in agreed stages, with regular demos and reviews so you can see progress, give feedback and adjust priorities as requirements evolve.
faq.4.question: How do you handle data security and confidentiality?
faq.4.answer: Security is built into everything we do. We sign NDAs before project kickoff, follow secure development practices (OWASP), encrypt data in transit and at rest, and can help you prepare for standards such as ISO 27001 and SOC 2.
faq.5.question: What happens after a project is delivered?
faq.5.answer: We offer ongoing maintenance and support plans. This includes bug fixes, performance monitoring, security updates, and feature enhancements. Ongoing support is optional; we can also hand the work over to your team.
faq.6.question: How do I get started?
faq.6.answer: Reach out through our contact form or by email. We'll schedule a free discovery call to understand your needs and propose a tailored approach.
